The three other board-safety suites' source-scan and footer mutations both pass here (v0.60.0), which is why this stayed a candidate a release longer — its checks assert BEHAVIOUR, and the anchor had to be found against what it actually does.

mutations.why: A file the guard has never been told about, carrying the prose the guard forbids. The editing form of a mutation cannot express this property: every edit lands in a file the list already names, so it proves the vocabulary scan and says nothing about the population that scan reads. That is precisely how this suite went on asserting `scanned == len(FILES)` — the length of its own tuple — while a shipped file sat outside it and a planted constant in that file passed (BL-211). Aimed at `scripts/` because this skill's measured gap was there: `scripts/score_register.py`, the engine that writes most of the strings these renderers print, sat outside the tuple with nothing saying so — next to `renderers/render_dashboard.py`, which was excluded WITH a reason. An exclusion is fine and an omission is not, and a hardcoded tuple cannot tell you which one it is looking at.
defeats: no confidence vocabulary in any shipped source but render_dashboard
